svg.aria-label: Two ways to spread attention over a long sequence. Left, FlashDecoding, 2023: in decoding one new query attends to a long KV cache, which is split into chunks processed in parallel by different thread blocks. Each block returns a partial output o_c with its own running max m_c and sum l_c, and a final reduce combines them with the same rescaling trick, M is the max of the m_c and O is the sum of e to the (m_c minus M) times o_c divided by the sum of e to the (m_c minus M) times l_c. Right, Ring Attention, 2023: four GPUs in a ring, each holding one chunk of the queries and one chunk of K and V. At each step every GPU computes attention of its Q chunk against the K and V chunk it currently holds, then sends that chunk to the next GPU, so GPU 1 sees KV1, KV4, KV3 and KV2 over four steps and every Q chunk has seen all of K and V. The send overlaps with compute, so the sequence can be longer than one GPU's memory.
